name: @latticekit/city
description: CITY BLOCK — a gallery exhibit. Dense setback massing and a rhythm of warm windows on a dark face.
$comment: Six of nine. `sim`, `persist` and `audio` are absent and that is the exhibit rather than an oversight: a city block has no economy, no save, and — a finding — no sound, because ninety seconds of skyline did not earn an AudioContext that a browser will not start until the visitor clicks. `input` and `loop` arrive through examples/_shared's bootstrap and are declared here because they are what this exhibit runs on.
